references.phrase: categories fibred in setoids over C
natural transformations over identity arrows of C
references.context: Category theory: natural transformations between functors over a base whose components project to identities

references.disposition: The restriction is essential: arbitrary natural transformations between the underlying functors are not the same 2-morphisms.

review_rationale: Read the object, 1-morphism, and 2-morphism clauses of the fibred-setoid 2-category, ensuring that natural transformations lie over identity arrows of the base and functors commute with projections.
